description: Search well permits in one US state by county or operator and optional permit-date range. The tool checks the core API's measured state-health gate first, fails closed for unavailable/attention states, and always returns freshness, date coverage, source provenance, and any staleness/degradation caveat with the records. Operator and county filters currently require separate searches.

county.description: Optional county-name search. Cannot be combined with operator.

operator.description: Optional operator-name search. Cannot be combined with county.

state.description: Required US state name or 2-letter code, e.g. Texas or TX.

name: opa_search_well_permits
title: Search Well Permits
